analyst_view.overall: Sabah are 31st of 36 with 3 points (one win, over Slavia) and Barcelona 5th with 9, so Barcelona need the win to stay in the top 8 while Sabah are fighting to stay alive. Sabah lose defender Aden McCarthy, sent off in the 4-1 defeat at Viking, and the numbers already count his ban. Barcelona's absences are not in the numbers at all: Rodri (hamstring) will not travel to Baku according to two reports, Xavi Espart (ankle) and Roony Bardghji (cruciate ligament) are out, and Dani Olmo, Pau Cubarsí and Jules Koundé are coming back from injuries and lack rhythm. Hansi Flick's side also host Villarreal on Sunday before the long trip to Baku and play Deportivo next weekend, so some rotation is likely; no referee is named yet. I trim Barcelona's very high attacking numbers a little and leave cards and corners with the numbers.

goals.text: The numbers say 5.2 goals (1.0 Sabah, 4.2 Barcelona), already counting Barcelona's strong scoring run and McCarthy's ban for Sabah, but no Barcelona absences. Rodri is out, Olmo is short of rhythm and a long trip after a Sunday game against Villarreal points to some rotation, so I lean a little lower on what is a very high total: about 4.9.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.7 corners, 6.5 of them for Barcelona as the side that will have most of the ball against a deep Sabah block. Rotation could make Barcelona a bit less sharp, but a deep defence still concedes plenty of corners, so I stay at 9.7.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.5 cards, already counting Sabah's high recent card count (+10.9%), which fits a side chasing the ball all night, and Barcelona's quieter spell (-5.2%). No referee is named yet and I see nothing beyond that, so I stay at 4.5.

shots.text: The numbers say 33.7 shots (8.8 Sabah, 24.9 Barcelona), already lifted for Barcelona's recent shooting (+7.3%). A rotated Barcelona without Rodri controlling midfield, after a Sunday game and a long flight, may shoot a little less than their recent peak, so I trim to about 32.0.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 12.5 shots on target, already raised for Barcelona's sharp recent finishing (+10%). The same reasons, Rodri out, Olmo short of rhythm and likely rotation, point slightly lower, to about 11.9.
